## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, Studio keys, or `DATABASE_URL` in the diff
- [ ] Docs / `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` updated when behaviour changes
- [ ] `VERSION` bumped only for a release
- [ ] Feature branch is based on `develop`
